about.title: About Crum
about.text:
Crum is a dessert kitchen with a deliberately short menu: Tiramisu and Classic Lotus Crumb.

Each is offered in three sizes, from a Single Serving for a quiet evening to a Dawat Serving for the whole table, and delivered across Lahore.

policies.refund:
• Cancel before we start preparing your order and your payment is refunded in full.
• If we cancel your order or cannot deliver on your date, your payment is refunded in full within 24 hours.
• Once preparation has started, the payment is non-refundable.
• If your order arrives damaged or incorrect, send a photo on the day of delivery. We will replace it or refund you.
policies.terms:
• We deliver within Lahore only.
• Prices are in Pakistani Rupees and may change.
• Desserts are perishable. Keep them refrigerated and enjoy them fresh.
policies.privacy: Your name, phone number and address are used only to process and deliver your order. We do not share them with anyone except the rider who delivers your order.
